ours.method: ROME via EasyEdit commit 14cea8245f06, shipped hparams/ROME/llama3-8b.yaml, Llama-3.1-8B (base, bf16)
ours.protocol: 1,000 CounterFact edits applied sequentially (single edits, cumulative), rewrite_acc scored by EasyEdit immediately after each edit (per-edit metric, before later edits) - the per-100-block curve shows the collapse trajectory

alphaedit_table1_llama3_8b_rome.source: Fang et al., AlphaEdit, arXiv:2410.02355 (ICLR 2025), Table 1, LLaMA3 (8B), Counterfact
alphaedit_table1_llama3_8b_rome.protocol: 2,000 samples drawn from the dataset, 100 samples per edit step (sequential)
alphaedit_table1_llama3_8b_rome.efficacy_definition: average top-1 accuracy on the edit samples (paper text)

caveats: metric: EasyEdit rewrite_acc = teacher-forced token accuracy over the target tokens; AlphaEdit Efficacy = top-1 accuracy on the edit sample (their code compares target_new vs target_true probability). Not the same quantity.
N and schedule: ours 1,000 single sequential edits; theirs 2,000 samples in steps of 100.
model: ours Llama-3.1-8B base; theirs LLaMA3 (8B).
our harness number (rank-1 of the gold token over the full vocabulary) is a stricter criterion than either.
